feat(jetowl_bridge): add vision_mcu link for JetOwl_Vision (#98)

* feat(jetowl_bridge): add vision_mcu link for JetOwl_Vision

Read the JetOwl_Vision camera board (STM32N655 + IMX335) over micro-ROS
on the agent the JetOwl FC already uses.

- vision_mcu.hpp/.cpp (ROS-free): status decoding, image geometry
  validation (64-bit), stream monitor: rate, exact missing-image count
  m = round(dt/T) - 1 for |j2 - j1| < T/2, latency, end-to-end loss
  against the firmware preview_sent counter (reboot-safe)
- node: subscribe /jetowl_vision/image_preview + /jetowl_vision/status,
  republish valid images on vision_mcu.output_topic, diagnostics
  jetowl_bridge/vision_mcu: link | image + firmware status
- launch vision_mcu:=true (agent when fc or vision_mcu), config block,
  README contract, package 0.3.0
- tests: test_vision_mcu (9) + 2 node tests; 69 gtests pass on Humble

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(server_ota): add JetOwl MCU OTA manifest, upload and reports

- GET /api/ota/manifest?device=jetowl_fc|jetowl_vision&version=...
  serves the newest valid JOWL v1 package (header, CRC-32 and payload
  SHA-256 verified server-side) as key=value text for the MCUs.
- POST /api/ota/report and GET /api/ota/devices record device state.
- /upload is implemented: size limit, safe file names, package
  validation, no overwrite of an existing release.
- /download rejects path traversal and quotes Content-Disposition;
  RespondError sets Content-Type before WriteHeader.
- Go tests with a golden package shared with the firmware host tests.

* docs(flowcharts): ROS 2 node graph of 3 repos

Single Mermaid flowchart of every ROS 2 node in JetOwl_FlightControl,
JetOwl_Vision and Isaac_ROS-Jetbot_NanoOWL (72 nodes + 9 external
nodes started by the repo launch files), wired by topics, services and
UDP/TCP/HTTP links, with the firmware control chains of both MCUs so the
closed loops are visible.

- Docs/flowcharts/ros2_nodes_flowchart.md: diagram, closed-loop table,
  node inventory with sources, unconnected topics and 11 mismatches
  found while tracing (e.g. /gps/velocity remap, /cmd_vel has no
  subscriber, RF launch executable names).
- images/ros2_nodes_flowchart.svg: pre-rendered, plain-SVG labels.
- render_flowchart.mjs: reproducible render (mermaid 12, dagre).

* fix(control_system): wire GNSS velocity and obstacles

- ESKF: gnss/velocity <- /gps/vel_cov (the bridge's ENU velocity with
  covariance); /gps/velocity had no publisher.
- MPC: obstacles <- /tracked/markers. CUBE markers accepted, each
  reduced to its smallest centred bounding sphere (obstacle_geometry.hpp);
  markers moved to world_frame by tf2 or the ESKF pose, expired by
  their lifetime.
- Fix the cylinder bounding radius: 1/2 max(s) did not enclose a tall
  cylinder; now 1/2 sqrt(d^2 + h^2).
- baro_sigma traced to the BMP280 datasheet of the JetOwl FC.
- test_obstacle_geometry.

* feat(flight_controller)!: cmd_vel input for MANUAL

- odom_topic defaults to /odometry/filtered (ESKF); /odom had no publisher.
- telemetry_logger reads odometry/filtered (flight/state was never
  published).
- MANUAL mode reachable via nav commands MANUAL / MANUAL_RELEASE and
  fed by joy or, with manual.source = cmd_vel, by a heading-frame
  geometry_msgs/Twist (e.g. the target follower).
- Fix: manual commands are rotated to the world frame by the estimated
  heading, v_w = R_z(psi) v_h; signal loss is checked on the control
  loop clock, so a source that stops publishing is detected.

BREAKING CHANGE: the world-frame velocity output is renamed cmd_vel ->
flight/cmd_vel; by REP-103 cmd_vel is a body/heading-frame command.

* feat(matlab): ROS 2 read/pub toolkit and 3D/2D viz

Add a MATLAB toolkit that reads the JetOwl ROS 2 graph and draws it.

- jetowl_ros2_viz: demo / live (ROS_DOMAIN_ID, 5 Hz timer) / bag
  playback in one figure: 3-D scene (ESKF trail, attitude, GNSS,
  setpoint, MPC path, mission, obstacle bounding spheres), 2-D SLAM
  map with scan and 95 % ellipse, position, altitude (ESKF/baro/GNSS),
  attitude vs setpoint (yaw on its own axis), rotor RPM
- JetOwlRos2Session: list_topics, subscribe with per-topic QoS
  (transient-local for /map, /slam/path, /mission/preview), ring-buffer
  history, publish_nav_command, publish_waypoints; generic publish
  refuses actuator topics unless AllowActuatorTopics is set
- utilities/ros2: pure functions with cited sources (Kuipers, REP-103/
  105/117/145, WGS-84 / Groves, ICAO ISA, Bar-Shalom chi-square gate)
- test_ros2_viz_suite: 11 groups, passing in GNU Octave 8.4 incl. the
  headless dashboard; wired into test_runner_all
- Node graph: matlab_jetowl_viz added, SVG re-rendered (273 edges)

* feat(matlab): Simulink function blocks, SLAM view

Simulink models built only from MATLAB Function blocks, plus a
real-time SLAM view.

- simulink/blocks: 31 block files (clock, 18 ROS 2 sources, 7 pure
  %#codegen processing blocks, flight and SLAM view sinks, command
  step and an edge-triggered flight/nav_command publisher); fixed
  signal sizes in jetowl_blk_sizes
- runtime: jetowl_sl_bridge (live / bag / demo / state source,
  reproducible playback cursor) and jetowl_sl_scope (ring buffers,
  redraw at redraw_hz with the same figures as jetowl_ros2_viz)
- jetowl_build_monitor_model builds a 25-block model from
  jetowl_monitor_wiring (fixed step 0.05 s, pacing 1x);
  jetowl_monitor_sil runs the same graph without Simulink
- SLAM view: map, keyframes, pose with 95 % ellipse and 2 sigma yaw,
  scan, NIS with exact chi-square bounds (A&S 26.4.19, Bar-Shalom
  5.4.2), innovations, ICP quality, degeneracy, sigma, timing, map
  areas; jetowl_ros2_viz gains a views option
- dashboard split into jetowl_viz_data and jetowl_viz_draw
- catalog: /slam/debug; /slam/pose carries the yaw variance
- test_simulink_blocks_suite: 9 groups, passing in GNU Octave 8.4
  with the test-only coder shims; flowchart node label updated
